profile.research_note: [batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This facility is located in the Pewaukee, Waukesha County, Wisconsin area, attributed to We Energies, the trade name of Wisconsin Electric Power Company, a major electric and natural gas utility serving southeastern Wisconsin, part of the Milwaukee headquartered WEC Energy Group. We Energies maintains a documented business office and service presence in the Waukesha County area according to the company own site and third party listings. Large investor owned utilities like We Energies typically operate significant internal IT infrastructure to support grid monitoring and control systems, customer billing and data platforms, and corporate administration, consistent with an enterprise private data center, but a published, dedicated source specifically describing a named Pewaukee data center, its size, or its capacity was not found. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.
